name: Create content property for attachment
description: Create content property for attachment Creates a new content property for an attachment. POST /wiki/api/v2/attachments/{attachment-id}/properties
context:
POST /wiki/api/v2/attachments/{attachment-id}/properties
Creates a new content property for an attachment. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to update the attachment.
Required: attachment-id (path) — The ID of the attachment to create a property for.; body (body) — The content property to be created

name: Delete attachment
description: Delete attachment Delete an attachment by id. DELETE /wiki/api/v2/attachments/{id}
context:
DELETE /wiki/api/v2/attachments/{id}
Delete an attachment by id. Deleting an attachment moves the attachment to the trash, where it can be restored later. To permanently delete an attachment (or "purge" it), the endpoint must be called on a **trashed** attachment with the following param `purge=true`. **[Permissions](https://support.atlassian.com/confluence-cloud/docs/what-are-confluences-roles/) required**: Permission to view the container of the attachment. Permission to delete attachments in the space. [`manage/content`](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/confluence/rest/v2/api-group-space-permissions/#api-space-permissions-get) permission for the space (if attempting to purge). **Note:** To find the display name for each permission ID, call the [Get available space permissions](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/confluence/rest/v2/api-group-space-permissions/#api-space-permissions-get) API.
Required: id (path) — The ID of the attachment to be deleted.
Optional: purge (query) — If attempting to purge the attachment.

name: Delete content property for attachment by id

name: Get attachment by id
description: Get attachment by id Returns a specific attachment. GET /wiki/api/v2/attachments/{id}
context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/attachments/{id}
Returns a specific attachment. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to view the attachment's container.
Required: id (path) — The ID of the attachment to be returned. If you don't know the attachment's ID, use Get attachments for page/blogpost/custom content.
Optional: version (query) — Allows you to retrieve a previously published version. Specify the previous version's number to retrieve its details.; include-labels (query) — Includes labels associated with this attachment in the response. The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order. A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.; include-properties (query) — Includes content properties associated with this attachment in the response. The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order. A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.; include-operations (query) — Includes operations associated with this attachment in the response, as defined in the `Operation` object. The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order. A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.; include-versions (query) — Includes versions associated with this attachment in the response. The number of results will be limited to 50 and sorted in the default sort order. A `meta` and `_links` property will be present to indicate if more results are available and a link to retrieve the rest of the results.; include-version (query) — Includes the current version associated with this attachment in the response. By default this is included and can be omitted by setting the value to `false`.; include-collaborators (query) — Includes collaborators on the attachment.

name: Get attachment comments
description: Get attachment comments Returns the comments of the specific attachment. GET /wiki/api/v2/attachments/{id}/footer-comments
context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/attachments/{id}/footer-comments
Returns the comments of the specific attachment. The number of results is limited by the `limit` parameter and additional results (if available) will be available through the `next` URL present in the `Link` response header. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to view the attachment and its corresponding containers.
Required: id (path) — The ID of the attachment for which comments should be returned.
Optional: body-format (query) — The content format type to be returned in the `body` field of the response. If available, the representation will be available under a response field of the same name under the `body` field.; cursor (query) — Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the `next` URL in the `Link` response header. Use the relative URL in the `Link` header to retrieve the `next` set of results.; limit (query) — Maximum number of comments per result to return. If more results exist, use the `Link` header to retrieve a relative URL that will return the next set of results.; sort (query) — Used to sort the result by a particular field.; version (query) — Version number of the attachment to retrieve comments for. If no version provided, retrieves comments for the latest version.

context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/attachments/{attachment-id}/properties

Required: attachment-id (path) — The ID of the attachment for which content properties should be returned.
Optional: key (query) — Filters the response to return a specific content property with matching key (case sensitive).; sort (query) — Used to sort the result by a particular field.; cursor (query) — Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the `next` URL in the `Link` response header. Use the relative URL in the `Link` header to retrieve the `next` set of results.; limit (query) — Maximum number of attachments per result to return. If more results exist, use the `Link` header to retrieve a relative URL that will return the next set of results.

name: Get labels for attachment
description: Get labels for attachment Returns the labels of specific attachment. GET /wiki/api/v2/attachments/{id}/labels
context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/attachments/{id}/labels
Returns the labels of specific attachment. The number of results is limited by the `limit` parameter and additional results (if available) will be available through the `next` URL present in the `Link` response header. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to view the parent content of the attachment and its corresponding space. Only labels that the user has permission to view will be returned.
Required: id (path) — The ID of the attachment for which labels should be returned.
Optional: prefix (query) — Filter the results to labels based on their prefix.; sort (query) — Used to sort the result by a particular field.; cursor (query) — Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the `next` URL in the `Link` response header. Use the relative URL in the `Link` header to retrieve the `next` set of results.; limit (query) — Maximum number of labels per result to return. If more results exist, use the `Link` header to retrieve a relative URL that will return the next set of results.

context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/attachments/{id}/operations
Returns the permitted operations on specific attachment. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to view the parent content of the attachment and its corresponding space.

name: Get attachments
description: Get attachments Returns all attachments. GET /wiki/api/v2/attachments
context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/attachments
Returns all attachments. The number of results is limited by the `limit` parameter and additional results (if available) will be available through the `next` URL present in the `Link` response header. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to view the container of the attachment.
Optional: sort (query) — Used to sort the result by a particular field.; cursor (query) — Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the `next` URL in the `Link` response header. Use the relative URL in the `Link` header to retrieve the `next` set of results.; status (query) — Filter the results to attachments based on their status. By default, `current` and `archived` are used.; mediaType (query) — Filters on the mediaType of attachments. Only one may be specified.; filename (query) — Filters on the file-name of attachments. Only one may be specified.; limit (query) — Maximum number of attachments per result to return. If more results exist, use the `Link` header to retrieve a relative URL that will return the next set of results.
